plugin.name: Resident Evil 5 Fusion Fix
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the field of view of the gameplay camera, which already widens with the screen (Hor+). Aiming and cutscenes keep theirs.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the logos and the logo movie at start-up.
WindowMode.description: The window when the game's own fullscreen option is off: with a frame, or borderless. A window as big as the screen has its frame outside the screen.
LightSyncRGB.description: Show both players' health on supported Logitech keyboards. Requires Logitech G HUB.
ColorFilter.description: The yellow-orange colour grade of the levels. Off shows the scenes in neutral colours; the game's own Special Settings filters still work.
ModernControls.description: Controls like Resident Evil 6: a free over-the-shoulder camera, movement relative to the camera, walking while aiming, using the knife, reloading and switching weapons, one-button reload, quick turn and dodges. Pad and keyboard/mouse.
KnifeParry.description: Swing or raise the knife just before an enemy's melee attack or grab lands to block it: the enemy staggers and can be hit with a melee attack. A grab that already holds you can't be parried.
ForceLaserSight.description: Aim with the weapon's laser sight on keyboard/mouse too, exactly as with a pad: the laser shows and the crosshair is hidden.
WFP_PLUGINS_HELP: Settings of the Fusion Fix and the other plugins.
WFP_PRESET_HELP: Vanilla: the original game with only bugs fixed. Recommended: the modern setup. Enhanced: everything on.
WFP_RESTOREDEFAULTS_HELP: Sets this page's settings to their defaults.
WFP_RESTART_WARNING: Restart the game to apply the changed settings.
